column1: # Single-gene lesions: deletions that are findings in their own right.
# The fusion dictionary is a partner-pair table. It cannot express a lesion
# with one gene, so recurrent deletions of IKZF1, CDKN2A/B, PAX5, ETV6 and
# EBF1 - among the commonest alterations in B-ALL - had nowhere to land and
# reported as nothing. This file is the deletion counterpart of
# focal_duplication_targets.tsv and shares its shape.
# Detection is by interval overlap with the gene body, not by what the
# breakends were named. That matters: the CDKN2A/B deletion observed here has
# both breakends outside either gene body, so a label-based rule misses it
# while an overlap rule does not.
# TIER. The fusion dictionary uses defining / actionable / emerging, none of
# which fits a prognostic copy-number alteration: these are not entity-
# defining in WHO or ICC, and there is no targeted therapy. `risk` is added
# here rather than to the fusion dictionary, which is left alone.
# THRESHOLDS are provisional and set from five observed calls across three
# samples, not from a truth set. min_frac is the fraction of the gene body
# the deletion must cover; min_len is an absolute floor, needed because
# CDKN2B is 6.4 kb and a fraction alone would admit indel noise; min_support
# matches the callers' own floor.
# NOT DISTINGUISHED: partial versus whole-gene loss. IKZF1 Delta-4-7 is the
# dominant-negative form and behaves differently from haploinsufficiency, but
# telling them apart needs exon coordinates and is not done here.
gene
IKZF1
column10: 76% in adult Ph+ ALL (GMALL). IKZF1plus requires a co-deletion and this table cannot assert it: BTG1 is off-panel. Delta-4-7, the dominant-negative form, is not distinguished from whole-gene loss

column1: CDKN2A
column10: 45% in adult Ph+. Pooled HR ~2.15 for OS across 13 studies. Independent in adults and in BFM paediatric cohorts; contested as a standalone in other childhood series (EORTC 58881/58951). Component of IKZF1plus and the UKALL CNA profile

column1: CDKN2B
column10: Usually co-deleted with CDKN2A. The gene body is 6.4 kb, so min_len sits below the others or 0.15 of it would fall into indel noise

column1: PAX5
column10: 43% in adult Ph+. PAX5alt group. Distinct from a PAX5 fusion, which the fusion dictionary handles

column1: ETV6
column10: 5% in adult Ph+, commoner in paediatric disease. Distinct from ETV6::RUNX1. min_frac is set by this gene: the observed call is 48.6 kb over a 245 kb body, three callers, 13 reads

column1: EBF1
column10: 13% in adult Ph+. Distinct from EBF1::PDGFRB, which the fusion dictionary handles

column1: TP53
column10: Uncommon in B-ALL outside hypodiploidy and relapse, where it is a marker rather than a target. On-panel for ELN risk in AML
